name: Pagination
element: nav, ul, li, a, button, input
summary: The pages of a long list, with the previous and next arrows at either end and the current page filled in. The arrows are chevrons drawn from two borders.
summaryZh: 长列表的页码,两端是上一页和下一页,当前页填上底色。箭头是用两条边框画出来的尖角。

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: Shorter buttons and a smaller label, for a pager that sits in a table footer.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The arrow at the end of the run has nowhere to go, so it is a real disabled button.

parts.name: Link
parts.note: The page itself. It is an <a> for a page you can go to and a <button> for the two arrows, because an arrow can be disabled and a link cannot.

parts.name: Active
parts.note: The page the reader is on. Its number is filled in, and it carries aria-current="page".

parts.name: Previous
parts.note: The arrow that goes back one page.

parts.name: Next
parts.note: The arrow that goes forward one page.

parts.name: Total
parts.note: How many records there are in all.

parts.name: Jumper
parts.note: The field that takes a page number and goes there.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The number field inside the jumper.

props.name: total
props.description: How many records there are. It is what the total line and the last page number are counted from.
props.descriptionZh: 一共多少条记录。总数那行和最后一个页码都是从它算出来的。

props.name: currentPage
props.description: Which page is open. It is the aria-current="page" on that page's item.
props.descriptionZh: 当前是第几页。它是那一页条目上的 aria-current="page"。

props.name: pageSize
props.description: How many records one page holds.

props.name: size
props.description: How big the buttons are. The default size is the base class on its own; the small size adds um-pagination--sm.
props.descriptionZh: 按钮有多大。默认大小是只写基类;小号再加上 um-pagination--sm。

a11y.notes: The pager is a <nav> with an aria-label, so a screen reader can jump past it. The current page carries aria-current="page", which is what tells the reader where they are without relying on the fill. The two arrows are <button>s rather than links, because an arrow at the end of the run has to be disableable and a link cannot be disabled.
a11y.notesZh: 分页器是一条带 aria-label 的 <nav>,读屏可以直接跳过。当前页带 aria-current="page",靠它告诉读者人在哪一页,而不是靠那块底色。两个箭头是 <button> 而不是链接 —— 走到头时箭头得能被禁用,而链接不能禁用。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Five pages, the first one open. The previous arrow is a disabled button, because there is no page before the first one.
examples.descriptionZh: 五页,停在第一页。上一页是禁用状态的按钮,因为第一页前面没有页了。

examples.title: With a total and a jumper
examples.description: The total line, the page size and the jumper field. The jumper is a real number field with its own label, so it announces what it wants.
examples.descriptionZh: 总数那行、每页条数和跳页输入框。跳页是一个真正的数字输入框,有自己的标签,所以读屏会说明它要什么。

notes: The arrows are chevrons drawn from two borders, and they take `currentColor`, so an arrow is disabled by the same rule as the label beside it. A text arrow would have to be a character in the markup, and the library would have to choose which one — `‹`, `«` or an image — and the choice would then sit in the document instead of in the theme.
notesZh: 箭头是用两条边框画出来的尖角,用的是 `currentColor`,所以箭头变灰和旁边的文字走的是同一条规则。用字符做箭头的话,库就得挑一个 —— `‹`、`«` 还是一张图 —— 而且这个选择会散落到文档里,而不是留在主题里。
